description: This Java class defines the 'PaymentDetail' entity in a financial application, including its fields, constructors, and methods for creating and converting to data transfer objects.

classes.name: PaymentDetail
classes.description: Entity class representing payment details linked to a payment type, with fields for account number, check number, routing code, receipt number, and bank number.

methods.name: generatePaymentDetail
methods.description: Static factory method to create a PaymentDetail object from a PaymentType, JsonCommand, and a map of changes.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a PaymentDetail object with specified parameters.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the PaymentDetail entity to a data transfer object (PaymentDetailData).
